responsibilities: Design and build dimensional and semantic models, including star schemas, fact and dimension tables, and conformed and slowly changing dimensions
Shape the Gold-layer, last-mile data models that power enterprise reporting and analytics
Write and optimise SQL across varied data formats to support modelling and reporting needs
Build and maintain Git-based workflows and CI/CD pipelines for BI development
Partner with technical and non-technical stakeholders to refine requirements and translate them into reliable data models
Work alongside data engineers, analytics specialists, cloud developers and product managers as part of a pragmatic, agile analytics team
Report to the Chapter Lead – Analytics and contribute to the broader modernisation of EROAD's BI tooling and platform

evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: turns curated data into trusted, reusable analytical assets
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Trust, reliability and CI/CD language ("trusted, reusable analytical assets", "reliable data models") outweighs the single "pragmatic, agile" velocity phrase.
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: Errors affect internal enterprise reporting at a fleet-technology company; compliance appears only in the company description, so moderate.
evidence.collaboration_width: data engineers; analytics specialists; cloud developers; product managers
evidence.data_team_maturity: As EROAD modernises its reporting platform
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: An analytics chapter with a Chapter Lead and a reporting platform being modernised shows an existing, growing function ("As EROAD modernises its reporting platform").
evidence.jd_authorship: Shape the Gold-layer, last-mile data models that power enterprise reporting and analytics
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Bullets name specific modelling patterns (star schemas, slowly changing dimensions, Gold-layer models) and the reporting line, so the hiring manager likely wrote them.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The role owns the modelling layer consumed by reporting and analytics users across the business ("power enterprise reporting and analytics").
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The role will "own the modelling layer" while refining requirements with stakeholders and reporting to a chapter lead, so mixed.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: AI tooling appears only as an employee benefit; no AI skill is expected.
evidence.testing_framing: No testing or data quality signal.
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: CI/CD pipelines are named but no testing, data contract or data quality practice is mentioned.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Trust and reliability of models matter but are framed as delivery outcomes, not as a compliance or bad-data risk.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: contribute to the broader modernisation of EROAD's BI tooling and platform
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: The role modernises an existing reporting platform rather than building one from nothing.
